route.note: No reference uncertainty or application data; M2 and full M7 profiling not activated. Browser clipboard mutation handled through explicit local pending guard.

requirementCoverage.detail: Reusable exported native TypeScript factory and plain scoped CSS, no dependencies, React, icons or UI library. Loopback example built and rendered.
Exact default label and actual clipboard URL verified.
One copy call despite Space, Enter and repeated programmatic clicks while promise pending.
Link copied status returned to original label in observed 1987ms.
Simulated clipboard rejection and absent API both display useful inline error including address; rejection retry succeeds.
Native Tab/Enter/Space tested, focus retained, 3px visible focus ring and polite atomic live region; minimum 48px button height. Actual screen-reader speech unverified.
320px viewport, supplied German label wraps into 246x71px button with no clipping or horizontal page overflow. Rendered desktop/narrow layouts visually inspected.

assumptions: Requirement ID meanings mapped in brief.json from supplied task order, since the input listed IDs without individual descriptions.
Modern Chrome on loopback is the supported environment; browser permission remains outside the component.
English default labels and supplied German default-label stress only; localized pending/error/success content is a host responsibility.
decisions: Use a native button, synchronous pending guard and aria-disabled instead of native disabled to preserve focus.
Use one persistent polite atomic status region for pending/success/error; no simulated screen-reader claim.
Two-second reset is cancellable on repeat activation and component destruction.
Choose dark green and neutral system typography with no external assets, motion or icons; a compact context card keeps the example usable.
Each component owns its state; optional typed copy adapter permits deterministic tests while the default uses the actual browser clipboard.

observed.keyboard: Space starts; repeated Enter, Space and programmatic clicks guarded

limitations: Timing starts at first successful UTC timestamp and excludes initial intake plus failed Get-Date command; see timing-and-deviations.txt.

Cross-browser, real-device, OS screen-reader, forced-colors, manual zoom and scanner checks were not performed; no conformance claim.

Only default label is stress tested in German. Error and pending messages are English by default.
No network access, package installations or writes outside the assigned trial.
